item.summary: fix(agents): canonicalize auth profile aliases (#119505) Persist inherited per-agent order references, collapse equivalent auth-provider state keys onto the canonical provider, and clear every equivalent persisted key. Make auth-order validation and display alias-aware while leaving separate OAuth runtime-cache behavior unchanged. Fixes #119233 Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger
